name: Hunter vs Four
hook: Fix the generators. Open the gate. Don't get caught.
how: Four survivors stand still at generators to fix them while the hunter prowls the yard. Fix three and the gates open: get out. Caught survivors go to the cage until a friend stands next to it and lets them out. The hunter wins if most of them never leave.
controls: WASD or hold the mouse to walk, Shift to run, Space to lunge as the hunter, or the touch stick and buttons
uses: The host's browser decides repairs, catches, rescues and escapes; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill both sides: survivors fix, flee and rescue; a bot hunter listens for running and rattling generators.
Every survivor, generator, cage and gate is the same for everyone.
The hunter's screen hides survivors it can't see, but every position is in the room state, so dev tools would show them.
The most points anyone scored in one night.
ideas: Add lockers survivors can hide in
Make the hunter invisible until it's close
Add a flashlight that stuns the hunter for a second
